name: Debarghya Das
role: CS Grad, Cornell (creator of Deedy Resume)
standout_features: Most iconic LaTeX resume in tech. 5K+ GitHub stars, 100K+ Overleaf uses. Instantly recognizable layout with clean hierarchy and strong white space.
content_strategy: Concise bullet-pointed achievements. Technical precision in project descriptions. Clear delineation between work, research, and projects.
key_sections: Education, Experience, Research, Awards, Publications, Skills

name: Sourabh Bajaj
standout_features: DYLAN'S DESIGN FAVORITE. Clean LaTeX layout. Section headers with horizontal rules. Nested bullet hierarchy (main for company, sub for projects). Bold company names, italic roles, right-aligned dates. Professional typography.
content_strategy: Project-based sub-bullets under each role. Describes what each project IS then what he DID. Tech context woven into descriptions naturally.

name: Aanand Kainth
role: SDE at Amazon AWS Managed Kafka
standout_features: DYLAN'S CONTENT FAVORITE. Every bullet quantifies impact with hard numbers. Bolds key metrics ($73k/month, 91% reduction). Skills categorized at top.
content_strategy: Impact-driven: every bullet ties technical work to business value. Bolds the numbers so they pop on scan. Format: 'Did X using Y, resulting in Z metric'.

name: Andrej Karpathy
role: Early career Stanford CS (later: Tesla AI Director, OpenAI co-founder)
standout_features: Historical artifact: resume of one of AI's most influential leaders from before he was famous. Shows how top talent presents early-career work.
content_strategy: Academic focus on research and publications. Emphasis on ML/CV expertise. Clean professional presentation.

name: Anusha Balakrishnan
standout_features: Uses embedded logos and icons for visual interest. Helvetica Neue typography. Color usage beyond black and white. Hyperlinked references.
content_strategy: Concise without lengthy descriptions. Selective highlighting of accomplishments. Links to external portfolios.

name: Jake Gutierrez
role: SWE Infrastructure at Clever (creator of Jake's Resume template)
standout_features: Creator of the famous 'Jake's Resume' template used by 50K+ engineers. Clean section labels left-aligned. Work Experience and Projects given equal weight.
content_strategy: Action-verb-led bullets. Concise 1-2 line bullets. Tech stack woven into descriptions. No fluff.
key_sections: Work Experience, Education, Projects, Technical Skills

name: Rishabh Garg
role: SDE II at Amazon AWS (Bedrock/LLM eval)
standout_features: Strong metrics throughout. Mixes industry (AWS, Goldman Sachs) with research (UT Austin). Publications section with Best Paper Award.
content_strategy: Quantifies everything: '30+ customers', 'reduce time by 90%', 'reducing monthly spend by 30%'. Role @ Company format. Dates left-aligned with bullets.

name: Brittany Chiang
role: Senior Frontend Engineer at Klaviyo (prev Apple, Starry, Upstatement)
standout_features: Most iconic developer portfolio in tech. Resume embeds hyperlinks to live projects/repos. Portfolio-driven narrative. Design system expertise shines through the resume's own design. Custom non-standard typefaces.
content_strategy: Demonstrated work over descriptions. Links to live projects (Halcyon VS Code theme, Spotify app). Roles at design-forward companies.

name: Yangshun Tay
role: Ex-Meta Staff Engineer, creator of Tech Interview Handbook & Blind 75
layout: Modern grid-based card system with company logos (SVG icons)
standout_features: Portfolio-driven resume with 14+ projects spanning 2013-2025. 35+ awards section. Web-native format (not PDF). Tech Interview Handbook used by millions. Shows side-project impact alongside FAANG work.
content_strategy: Projects-heavy with recognition archive and speaking engagements. Minimal bullet points — lets project links do the talking.

name: Pirate King
role: FAANG SWE (Microsoft, Amazon, eBay). $360k Google offer.
layout: Single-page Google Docs, dark and white themes
standout_features: Skills-first layout (no summary/objective). Business context over technical jargon. Quantified everything ($35.3B revenue, 80% latency reduction). Condensed old roles to one-liners. Openly shares 10 contrarian resume tips.
content_strategy: Skills at top, experience over education, embedded LinkedIn/GitHub links. Recent experience detailed, old roles minimal.

name: Byungjin Park (posquit0)
role: SRE / Software Architect, creator of Awesome-CV (25K+ GitHub stars)
layout: Multi-page, color-accented LaTeX with sidebar header
standout_features: Most-starred CV template on GitHub (25K+). Beautiful accent colors on headers and section bars. Multi-page format that still feels organized. Proves more than one page can work.
content_strategy: Detailed role descriptions with sub-projects. Clean semantic LaTeX markup. Color used as structural element.

name: Satvik Ramaprasad
role: SWE II at Databricks (now xAI). University Topper at IIIT-B.
standout_features: Fast-track promotion highlighted. Strong quantified metrics (500 pods, 100 shards, 3 clouds). Open source leadership (CircuitVerse.org — GSoC mentor org 6 years). Blends industry with open-source.
content_strategy: Metrics-driven bullets. Clear project impact. Open source as differentiator.

name: Daniel Phang (dphang)
layout: Single-page, modern Lato font, minimal sections
standout_features: Template used widely on Overleaf. Modern sans-serif (Lato) vs typical LaTeX Computer Modern. Extremely clean section dividers. Simplicity and font choice as differentiator.
content_strategy: Brief ATS-friendly bullets. Experience, Skills, Education in clear order. No visual clutter.

name: Erik Cupsa
role: Prev Amazon, Autodesk. CTO at Empor.
standout_features: Designed for technical roles. Highlights project experience alongside professional experience equally. Balances skills, work, and projects without crowding. Founder/CTO resume that reads like an engineer's.
content_strategy: Technical skills prominent. Project experience given equal weight to work experience. Clean customizable structure.

name: Riddhi Dutta
role: SWE III at Google (prev Amazon, Salesforce). Tier-3 college to FAANG.
standout_features: Inspiring Tier-3 college to Google story. Emphasizes naming your resume file strategically. Resume got interviews at Google, Amazon, Salesforce. Practical Medium article breaking down every section.
content_strategy: Role-focused bullets. Strategic file naming. Experience over education for non-target school grads.
